claims.text:
Your weight variance .5 made width times weight variance equal 1, preserving variance through three layers. At .125 it shrank to .0156; at 2 it grew to 64.0000. This recurrence assumes independent zero-mean linear inputs and weights; nonlinear networks need not preserve it.
